answer: One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is a bonded-identity registry where each agent must lock a stake of the network token to register, and peers attest to unique work history. Attackers creating many fake identities must pay the full stake per identity, plus fees to fabricate a sonnet of plausible attestations, making mass sybils economically irrational. Reputation accrues like a nebula slowly condensing, and slashing burns stake to basalt-hard permanence, so each forged identity costs real capital that is lost on detection.
